_comment: Arc Light collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed arc-light-tesla`, then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_arc.py, one thin module per look.

readme.title: Arc Light
readme.summary: Pokemon crackling with electric light: Tesla-coil bolts, plasma globes, welding sparks, thunderstorms, climbing Jacob's ladder arcs and ball lightning.
looks: each line wears one look: Tesla coil, dark steel with branching blue-white bolts (Skarmory, Baltoy, Blipbug); plasma globe, smoky glass with violet filaments reaching out from the heart (Espurr, Mimikyu, Greavard); welding, scorched metal with white-hot molten seams and spark showers (Slugma, Throh, Mudbray); thunderstorm, storm-cloud grey with yellow lightning (Wingull, Cramorant, Scorbunny); Jacob's ladder, arcs climbing up the body (Venipede, Wooper, Chi-Yu); ball lightning, glowing orbs of light with crackling halos (Scatterbug, Nickit, Chatot)
the arcs glow in the dark and re-strike every few frames; glowing eyes
shiny: the electric light turned round the colour wheel
